notes:
Lead source: inbound demo request via signup form (trial credit used).

Summary:
- Small SaaS that sells a conversational help widget to SMB merchants.
- Wants hosted API for speed of integration and self-serve trial.
- Primary concern is unpredictable traffic spikes after marketing pushes (instagram/newsletter).
- Goal = reliable conversational support + search fallback; target latency <300ms p95 for generation; ability to absorb short bursts up to ~1k req/min without large errors.

Recent activity / timeline:
- 2024-09-18: Intro call (Fireflies ff_2024-09-18_crestfall_intro). AE Ava intro, SE Jordan joined. Quick demo of hosted endpoints.
- 2024-09-22: Shared pricing deck + usage scenarios (drive link above).
- 2024-09-25: Follow-up email re: concurrency and 429 behavior (thread-CAK9J8x-crestfall-auth).
- 2024-10-02: Tech deep-dive w/ engineering (requested examples for burst handling and retry guidance).

Technical requirements / asks:
- Clear docs on rate limiting: per-token vs requests, how concurrency limits enforced, what triggers 429s.
- Burst handling: want temporary uplift or queued bursts; prefer short-term autoscaling/burst policy rather than manual escalation.
- Retries pattern: idempotency guidance and recommended backoff windows.
- Monitoring: need token-level billing visibility and request-level latency traces to map cost vs UX.
- Model choices: prefer small/fast model for chat (lower token cost) + fallback to larger model for complex queries; need routing fallback behavior documented.

POC plan (proposed):
- 14-day hosted API trial with 100k free tokens; developer integrates widget using SDK.
- Week 2: Traffic replay spike test using historical traffic file (~simulate 10x peak for 2 minutes) — verify 429 rate, failover path, and SLOs.
- Deliverable: short runbook for retry/backoff and recommended quota config.

Quotes / customer color:
- "If we get slammed after an email, we can’t have the widget fail — customers churn fast."
- "We need the predictability of costs — token surprises kill our margins."

Risks / blockers:
- Legal requests explicit data retention and audit logging (SOC2 evidence helps).
- Unclear whether self-serve onboarding will include temporary burst capacity — AE to confirm limits.

Next steps (short):
- AE to enable trial and send credentials + quickstart (Ava).
- SE Jordan to provide sample retry/backoff config and a recommended quota profile for SMB (by 2024-10-04).
- Schedule spike replay test (target week of 2024-10-07).
